question: Under what minimal condition is that one called supreme Śiva?
premises: A condition is stated as mere leaving of the body.
Upon that condition, he is called supreme Śiva.
The designation follows that condition alone.
inference: Upon merely leaving the body, he is called supreme Śiva.
uncertainties: Scope of the condition not expanded here
plain_english: Upon merely leaving the body, he is called supreme Śiva.
